description.value: Veerji Fish 'n' Grill is a BC-based Indian restaurant franchise with locations across the Fraser Valley and Interior, offering Indian cuisine including fish pakoras, tandoori dishes, biryanis, and a broad range of vegetarian options. The Mission outlet operates as a pickup and delivery location on the Lougheed Highway corridor. It is part of a family-run franchise group with over a dozen BC locations.
